placeabout.heading: About this place
placeabout.description:
Troopers Hill offers an unusual landscape for a Bristol day out. Its open slopes and historic chimney provide a setting for a short walk that feels different from a traditional city park.

Our family idea: find a comfortable, safe stopping point and see how many distant landmarks everyone can identify. Bring a sketchbook to capture the hill's outline rather than rushing to cover every path.

placepracticalinfo.heading: Practical information
placepracticalinfo.bestFor: Families with confident walkers who enjoy viewpoints and local history.
placepracticalinfo.facilities: Nature-reserve paths; the nearest public toilets are at St George Park.
placepracticalinfo.parking: Plan public transport or legal local parking and keep residential access clear.
placepracticalinfo.goodToKnow: Paths can be steep and uneven. Choose footwear with grip and keep children away from abrupt drops.

placevisitmap.travelNote: Plan public transport or legal local parking and keep residential access clear. Use this postcode for the arrival area, then follow local signs to the entrance. Google Maps can use your current location, or you can enter a starting point.
